page_title: ATM 5-0 PAL | Atletico Madrid v Las Palmas 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+3' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Jan Oblak, who gets down to save.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

87' 5 - 0 Goal! Great play by Rodrigo Riquelme releases Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top of the net. 5:0.
85' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
81' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pejino (Las Palmas) replacing Munir El Haddadi.
80' Alvaro Valles makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) after a cross from the side.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
76' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
74' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Sergi Cardona is replaced by Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas).

74' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Jan Oblak makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the left side of the target.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arthur Vermeeren (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Pablo Barrios can be given a rest.
70' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
69' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
67' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) for Marcos Llorente.
63' Substitution. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) in, Koke out.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) will be replaced by Axel Witsel.
63' Here comes a substitution. Samuel Lino is given a rest as he is replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
62' 4 - 0 Goal! Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Alvaro Valles.
62' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
61' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) picks up a yellow card.
61' The Atl. Madrid players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

59' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Atl. Madrid.
58' Substitution. Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) has come on for Alex Suarez.
58' Here is a change. Maximo Perrone is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sandro Ramirez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
57' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

54' What a poor attempt! Marvin (Las Palmas) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
51' The attendance is 61196.
50' The ball is cleared after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
47' 3 - 0 GOAL! Koke meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 3:0.
46' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
45+1' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
44' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul. Atl. Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
43' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
39' Las Palmas are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
35' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:1. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:0.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
30' A cross into the box from Marvin (Las Palmas) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Las Palmas.
30' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jan Oblak.
28' The resulting free kick from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
28' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
26' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak makes a magnificent save!
23' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
22' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
20' 2 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:0.
20' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside yet again.
19' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals. It's a free kick to Las Palmas in a dangerous position.

15' 1 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.
13' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
12' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar.
10' Koke (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Marcos Llorente, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

7' OFF THE POST! Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
6' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
5' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands.
5' Atl. Madrid win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
4' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) for his blatant foul. Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
3' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows the whistle, Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul.
2' One of the players from Atl. Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jorge Figueroa Vazquez.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
